2.description: Your ship is destroyed in a battle, misjump or accident. You are one of the few survivors. Gain a fellow survivor as a Contact.

3.description: You are disgraced by the actions of your ship, your captain, or yourself. Gain a Rival in the service.

4.description: You are court-martialled for a real or imagined offence. Whether or not you are convicted, you are forced out of the service.

5.description: A political scandal or shift in Imperial policy ends your career. Gain an Enemy among the admiralty.

3.description: Your ship engages an enemy vessel. Roll Gunner 8+ or Tactics (Naval) 8+; on success, gain one of Gunner 1 or Tactics (Naval) 1 and DM+1 to your next Advancement roll. On failure, roll on the Mishap Table (not ejected).

4.description: You are assigned to an isolated, long-range patrol. Gain one of Astrogation 1, Survival 1, Electronics 1 or Vacc Suit 1.

5.description: You are given a commendation. Gain DM+1 to any one Benefit roll.

6.description: You serve aboard a ship with an excellent captain. Gain them as a Contact or Ally.

8.description: You are sent to officer training or specialist school. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any one skill from the Officer or Advanced Education tables at level 1.

9.description: You distinguish yourself in a ship-to-ship engagement. Gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll.

10.description: You are transferred to an elite unit. Gain one of Gun Combat 1, Melee (Blade) 1, Vacc Suit 1 or Leadership 1, or transfer to the Marines without a Qualification roll.

11.description: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Gain one level in any skill you already have, or DM+4 to your next Advancement roll.

12.description: Your heroism in a major fleet action is noted by the Imperial court. You are automatically promoted and gain a medal.
